svg.title: 初始六组可见轮廓色块
svg.desc: Hand-drawn closed Bézier silhouettes in reference pixel coordinates. Six editable component groups. No embedded images. Crown and hair negative spaces preserved. Temporary garment is not a separate component.

g.desc: Parent completion: continuous rear hair beneath the neck, torso, pelvis and thighs; the central hanging lock joins this concealed rear mass. Original exposed contours, crown openings and outer hair-loop negative spaces are retained.
后脑固定发根同面补全：脸、前发、侧发及颈部遮挡大部分帽状面；正常头部转动时耳后窄面可露出。原root向x443/y336及neck向x327–414/y381连续延伸，已涵盖当前耳后至颈后完整接头；只变形同面，不另造后片、不把耳侧背景孔填掉。
中央后尾束同面补全：身体、骨盆与双腿遮住y812–1218的根段，末端在腿间露出。正常轻摆由上段宽32px发根接到hidden内面，保留完整812–1310连续形体与单尖；受运动驱动弯曲时连接仍在身体后方，不需独立后片或扩大父范围。

Same ear surface hidden beneath face_skin: medial root overlap supports modest head yaw and ear relative displacement; preserve approved visible helix and lobe. Render ear behind facial skin at final assembly.
Continuous rigid arch. Its two ends overlap the wing ornaments; preserve both shared curves.
Right ornament keeps its own pierced shapes and asymmetric upper branch. Inner short root at x474-487 y128-140 is concealed behind front hair. Ribbon hangs from a separate sibling group.
Left ornament keeps its pierced shapes and separate curling strips. Inner short root at x385-398 y127-140 is concealed behind front hair. Ribbon hangs from a separate sibling group.

Rigid blue crest with concealed back root at x430-442 y121-131. Stage 5 must keep this root behind front_hair while the visible crest remains in front of the bun; forehead_chain is a separate foreground group and must not inherit this hidden root.

Four pendant gems and connecting thin chain, x424-449 y116-219, remain in front of front_hair. The short crest back root belongs to center_crest and must be hidden behind hair, not drawn as a wider chain.
运动补齐：薄平带面由顶部穿环处随头部转动并向两侧轻摆；挂环遮住y179.85–184的尖顶接头，肩臂及后发遮住部分下行带面。现有连续闭合面从带顶至(273,544)保留完整同面，足以承接局部转动和弯曲露出；顶部孔是真实穿挂孔。无鞋口或袖口式独立内壁，不新增后片，不扩大已批准父范围。
运动补齐：带顶随饰链轻转，薄带面可左右摆动；下挂环遮住y180.45–183.5的尖顶接头，肩臂与后发遮住下行内缘局部。现有穿环重叠及从尖顶至(607,545)的闭合连续带面已覆盖正常相对位移露出；孔洞保持透明，同一平带面不需要另造内壁或背片，不改变已批准双缘及父范围。
Hidden upper stem extends into the earlobe to y269.4 for a stable pendant pivot and small relative shifts; the visible stem, jewel and lower chain stay unchanged.

Parent silhouette completion: keep the calibrated visible neck sides; add a rounded upper attachment behind the jaw and a smooth lower overlap beneath the torso. Hidden extensions only; collarbones remain assigned to body.

Continuous neck skin. Current approved silhouette rechecked for motion: the rounded upper reserve behind the jaw supports ordinary small head tilt and turn, and the broad lower reserve under the torso supports small neck-root relative motion. Retain the approved right-side hidden overlap and all visible edges. This is one continuous skin surface with no opening or separately stacked inner wall; no new part is needed. Collarbone detail belongs to body.

Continuous torso skin; retain the existing neck-root underlap, rounded shoulder-joint ends and lower-abdomen overlap for ordinary small turns, sway and bends. Hair, neck, upper arms and pelvis can reveal these same-surface areas. Existing reserve is sufficient for this contour stage; no separate back wall or garment part is needed.
肩根藏于前发与躯干交叠下，抬臂和头发摆动时露出同一完整圆肩面；肘下圆端覆盖前臂屈伸时的接合露出，现有范围充足，不新增背片。
圆形肘根承接绕肘屈伸，腕端完整圆弧承接手部轻转；同一皮肤面持续进入重叠区，不作袖口或独立后壁，现有范围足够。
完整腕根、手掌及所有指尖，保留原真实手内孔与开放指间隙。

Continuous pelvis surface. Existing rounded waist overlap and bilateral hip-root overlap retain coverage for modest relative torso and leg movement. Keep visible edges and the central leg gap; no separate back surface or inner wall is needed.
右肩根藏于前发和躯干交叠后，抬臂或头发摆动时露出同一完整圆肩面；肘下圆端承接前臂屈伸，现有余量充足，无独立后壁。
完整圆形肘根承接绕肘屈伸，腕端圆弧覆盖手部轻转；同一皮肤连续进入重叠区，现有余量足够，不新增腕带或机械关节片。
完整腕根、掌部、拇指与全部指尖，保留原真实手内孔及开放指间负形。
